name: Smuggler
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
body:
Drawbacks
Smuggler
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
Category Faction
Whether you’re carrying illegal contraband or simply regulated products, you have a knack for sneaking goods past watchful eyes. You gain a +3 bonus on Sleight of Hand checks made to hide an object, and Sleight of Hand is a class skill for you.
